title: Ask for a message
summary: T-SQL: Ask for a message. Change the name.
introduction: SELECT asks for a result. AS gives its column a name. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Ask for a message with T-SQL

blocks.text: Connect to a practice SQL Server database with SSMS or sqlcmd. Run one example at a time. Results below show cell values or PRINT text without grid headers.
SELECT returns the string as a one-cell result. AS names that result column.
